title: [bundle] Fix audit-found exhausted-backlog agent navigation conflict:
objective: Fix audit-found exhausted-backlog agent navigation conflict: hf status/resume JSON machine summary reports next_command="done" when no tasks remain, while rendered direction says hf handoff. This invalid bare done command can mislead agents. Make exhausted backlog next_command be a valid safe command (hf handoff), update resume commands accordingly, add regression proving status/resume JSON and text no longer emit bare done at all-done state, and sync docs/tests if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Regression tests assert all-done status/resume summaries use hf handoff, not bare done.
Focused cargo tests, hf task test, and drift audit pass with edits within path_scope.
